dialogue.text: And just when I thought I was screwed… Can you help me?
I… I really don't know what I am doing. I have been wandering for days, barely being able to make sense of any of this.
One second, I am on vacation with no care in the world, and next...

options.text: I'm guessing this is your first earthquake?

dialogue.text: I guess I can't make it any more obvious. I can't stand being here anymore, I cannot understand anything. No one is helping me. I don't know... anything.

options.text: Here, I can teach you something.
Menko cards. Let's play... with a twist.
With our resources on the line.

dialogue.text: Hehe, I'm already starting to like you.
